title: A Blue Whale's Heart Weighed 180 Kilograms
description:
The blue whale is the largest animal known to have ever existed. The heart of one stranded North Atlantic blue whale weighed 180 kg, the largest known in any animal. The whale's body is greyish-blue on top and lighter underneath.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Blue whale'. The bathroom scale is a joke.

Which animal record shocks you most? Tell us in the comments.
